description: Controlled decomposition of the originally reported failure-class F1 of 0.5924. XGBoost throughout, identical hyperparameters, random_state=42; each row changes exactly one aspect of the evaluation protocol relative to the row above it.

steps.step: A. Row-level stratified split, threshold chosen on the test set
B. Commit-grouped split, threshold still chosen on the test set
C. Commit-grouped split, threshold chosen on a validation fold
